metrics.safe_capsule_bias: unknown; simulated voltage is not approved for hardware

operating_point.coverage: DC feasibility screen; device safe operating area remains a separate evidence gate

frequency_response.coverage: 1 Hz to 10 MHz, nominal environment; electrical model only

noise.coverage: Resistive fixture noise; conditional capsule sensitivity. Semiconductor and capsule mechanical noise unresolved.

distortion.coverage: Electronics under linearized imposed capsule motion; nominal only. Device/environment distortion corners remain pending.

headroom.coverage: Bracketed electronics distortion boundary if a failure exists; otherwise lower bound only. Mechanical overload and device power pending.

metrics.method: Full 2-port Y subtraction of feed/cable/preamp, preserving DUT DC operating point

metrics.common_mode_drive: Preamp input midpoint relative to supply earth; fixture susceptibility, not microphone intrinsic CMRR

phantom_supply.coverage: 8 DC/AC supply/feed extremes. Noise/distortion/abuse at corners pending.

temperature.coverage: 3 electrical temperatures; no validated mechanical or leakage temperature law

semiconductor_corners.reason: No manufacturer-bounded semiconductor corners; ideal fixtures cannot demonstrate no-selection yield

metrics.reason: Assumed scenario distributions and screening coverage; real production statistics unknown.
metrics.distributions: Independent uniform scenario ranges; leakage log-uniform; not manufacturer distributions

monte_carlo.reason: Initial Monte Carlo runs DC/AC screens only; all-requirement manufacturing yield is not established

metrics.definition: 3-port Y subtraction of the capsule; input C/G with other electrodes AC-clamped. Dynamic floating/bootstrap behavior is retained in raw Y matrix.

loading.coverage: Electrical loading and 16 assumed capsule corners; not an acoustic polar or mechanical model

startup.coverage: Symmetric cold turn-on PWL. Hot-plug, asymmetric pin connection, disconnect, RF/ESD pending.

metrics.reason: Closed-loop AC peaking cannot prove loop stability; declared injection ports/Nyquist or return-ratio tests required.

failure_reasons.semiconductor_corners: No manufacturer-bounded semiconductor corners; ideal fixtures cannot demonstrate no-selection yield
failure_reasons.monte_carlo: Initial Monte Carlo runs DC/AC screens only; all-requirement manufacturing yield is not established

next_potential_experiment: Resolve failed checks and missing evidence without changing acceptance thresholds.
